requirements.evidence: All contract items are present: Entity/EntityMembership/UserRole (app/Models/Entity.php:1-50, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:1-72, app/Models/UserRole.php:1-18), both policies (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php), factories, migrations with `entities_slug_unique`, `entity_memberships_entity_user_unique` and generated `owner_seq` + `entity_memberships_one_owner` (database/migrations/2026_10_29_000002_create_entity_memberships_table.php:827-831 in change.diff), middleware + alias (bootstrap/app.php:18-22), routes /home, onboarding, entity.switcher, entity.pick, entity.dashboard (routes/web.php:23-41), switcher Blade with `data-current="1"` (resources/views/entities/switcher.blade.php:8), navbar link only when `count() > 1` (resources/views/layouts/default-page.blade.php:14-16), lang keys in both locales, and docs/database-schema.md updated. Edge cases handled: slug retry loop plus empty-slug fallback (CreateEntity.php:71-84), 403 before the session write in EntityPickController.php:14-18.

conventions.evidence: Several mandated conventions are skipped: no tests anywhere (nothing under `tests/` in the diff) though `tdd` requires a test for every implemented behavior; the domain write (entity + owner membership) lives inline in the Livewire component (CreateEntity.php:33-46) instead of `app/Actions/*`; authorization uses `membershipFor()` instead of policies (EntityPickController.php:14, ResolveCurrentEntity.php:30, Dashboard.php:17) despite 'Authorization always goes through policies/gates'; the custom `current_entity` middleware is not registered with `Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware` (bootstrap/app.php:18); CHANGELOG.md is not updated. Positive: `#[Validate]` + `$this->validate()` (CreateEntity.php:18-23), generated-style migrations with reversible down(), deliberate `$fillable`, policies registered via Gate (AppServiceProvider.php:44-45), Blade components and Bulma markup.

security.evidence: No exploitable flaw found: name is validated server-side (CreateEntity.php:18-23), the pick endpoint checks membership before writing the session (EntityPickController.php:14-18), Dashboard::mount aborts 403 for non-members (Dashboard.php:13-19), all Blade output uses `{{ }}` (switcher.blade.php:5-11, dashboard.blade.php:2), and mass assignment is constrained by `$fillable`. But two Livewire-policy rules are broken: `submit()` never calls `$this->authorize(...)` (CreateEntity.php:21, rule 3) and the custom `current_entity` middleware is not persisted for Livewire updates (rule 6), and authorization is hand-rolled rather than policy-based in four places.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test files at all (`grep` for `tests/` returns nothing); there are no feature or unit tests for the migrations, models, policies, middleware, controllers, or Livewire components, hence no unauthorized-call or tamper tests for `CreateEntity::submit` or `Dashboard::mount`.

simplicity.evidence: The 0/1/many dispatch is duplicated verbatim in HomeController.php:14-30 and ResolveCurrentEntity.php:41-58, and the tenant entity is stored three ways at once - request attribute, `app()->instance('current_entity')` and a scoped `App\Support\CurrentEntity` (ResolveCurrentEntity.php:60-68) - when one would do. Otherwise the code is direct and reuses existing relations/helpers.

readability.evidence: Names are clear and methods focused (`membershipFor`, `uniqueSlug`, `setContext`); `submit()` (CreateEntity.php:21-69) is the longest method but reads linearly. Minor doc defect: `User::entities()` is annotated `@return BelongsToMany<User, $this>` (app/Models/User.php:31) although it relates Entity.

scope.evidence: Every change serves the task: models/policies/migrations/factories, the two Livewire pages, three controllers, middleware, routes, switcher view, navbar entry, lang keys and the required database-schema doc update; no unrelated refactors or out-of-scope screens (no members/settings page, no locale middleware, no dropdown redesign).

issues.explanation: The change ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests at all, so the models, policies, middleware, controllers and Livewire actions are unverified and the required unauthorized-call and tamper tests do not exist.
`submit()` is a public Livewire endpoint but never calls `$this->authorize('create', Entity::class)`, violating Livewire rule 3 even though `EntityPolicy::create` exists.
The custom `current_entity` middleware is only on the route, so it silently stops applying on subsequent Livewire update requests (rule 6); it must be registered as persistent middleware.
Authorization is done with ad-hoc `membershipFor()` checks instead of `$this->authorize(...)`/policies, which the conventions explicitly require.
Creating the entity and its owner membership is a domain write performed inline in the component rather than in an `app/Actions/*` class as the conventions require.
The resolved tenant is written to three places (request attribute, container instance, scoped CurrentEntity) when a single mechanism would suffice.
The 0/1/multiple membership dispatch logic is copied in two places and will drift when one changes.
No `[Unreleased]` entry was added even though the conventions require changelog updates and docs were otherwise kept in sync.
The `entities()` relation is annotated `@return BelongsToMany<User, $this>` but relates Entity, so the PHPDoc is wrong.

review.summary: The change implements the entity data model, policies, tenant middleware, onboarding, switcher, dashboard, navbar entry, lang keys and the schema doc, and the requirements are essentially complete. It cannot be approved because it ships zero tests, skips the required policy-based authorization on the Livewire onboarding action, and omits persistent middleware for `current_entity`; a few smaller convention and duplication issues remain.
